headline: Labor Protests Force Closure of 18 Garment Factories in Bangladesh
summary: Fresh labor unrest led to the temporary or indefinite closure of 18 garment factories in Gazipur, Bangladesh. Police deployed tear gas as workers assembled ahead of a official wage board consultation meeting.
why: Bangladesh is the world's second-biggest exporter of ready-made garments, supplying major international retail clothing chains.

impacts.name: Bangladesh
impacts.why: Factory shutdowns in Bangladesh's garment sector disrupt critical export earnings.
